messages:
alex: Planning enrichment rollout for analytics.events: add user_geo column + backfill from geo_service tonight at 00:45 UTC. Estimated 2h. Requesting deploybot pin to schema-v3.4.0 for the window and to disable canary in sa-east-1. Ack?
priya: Ack. How will backfill run and what's the shard plan?
alex: We'll run per-partition backfills across partitions 2024_01 -> 2024_12, one partition at a time, chunk-size=50k, concurrency=1. Backfill job calls geo_service and writes to events.user_geo. We'll add column (NULLable) first, then backfill, then set NOT NULL with default.
jon: Important: when flipping NOT NULL we should do it during low-traffic window and use the two-step (SET DEFAULT + backfill non-null rows + ALTER COLUMN SET NOT NULL). Also, expect brief schema lock during ALTER TABLE add column?
alex: Right. Plan: 00:45 add column user_geo TEXT; 00:50 start partition p2024_01 backfill; final set NOT NULL planned only after all partitions pass smoke tests.
priya: Abort criteria suggestion: sustained p99 DB latency >350ms for >8m OR API error rate +0.5% OR more than 3 geo_service failures per minute. Also if job queue backlog >500 for >10m.
\alon: (typo)
jon: small typo :point_up: 
priya: Also add replica_lag>90s to abort.
alex: Agree. Fallback if deploybot can't pin: flip feature flag 'events_geo_backfill' -> false and stop jobs. @jon can you manual-unpin if needed?
jon: I can manual-unpin and flip the flag. Will be on pager.
deploybot: schedule accepted. Pinning schema-v3.4.0 for release-group 'events-geo-enrich' at 3087654321. Canary disabled in sa-east-1. Will post progress every 10m and alert on p99/replica_lag/job_backlog thresholds.
data-bot: Added draft release note at release_notes/3087654321.md: "Add user_geo to analytics.events + partitioned backfill. Backfill reads from geo_service; brief schema locks when setting NOT NULL. Abort criteria listed in thread."
opsbot: Added monitoring hooks and pager thresholds. Will page on p99>350ms or replica_lag>90s or backlog>500.
priya: Rollback snippet (runbook):
```bash
# stop backfill runners
curl -X POST "https://internal.api/jobs/stop?group=events-geo-enrich" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"
# flip feature flag
psql -c "UPDATE feature_flags SET enabled=false WHERE name='events_geo_backfill';"
# manual unpin
deployctl pin --release-group events-geo-enrich --unpin
# optional: remove column if partially applied (after confirming no dependent writes)
psql -c "ALTER TABLE analytics.events DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS user_geo;"
```
alex: I'll start test partition p2024_01 at 00:55 UTC (+10m buffer). If it passes 15m smoke (no error spikes, geo_service success rate>99%), we'll proceed. Post backfill progress here every 15m.
jon: Will run smoke checks and synthetic load for 5m before each partition. Abort immediately if abort criteria met.
priya: Oncall and monitoring. DM me on thresholds.
alex: Thanks team — will post first status at +15m after start.
